_comment: Core NPC definitions for the Goblin Slayer campaign. Full personal memories live in memories/<id>.json.

grak-split-ear.name: Grak the Split-Ear
grak-split-ear.description: Scarred older male goblin, larger and heavier than average. One ear is torn nearly in half. Rules through strength and the fear it creates.
grak-split-ear.currentGoal: Keep the nest fed and himself on top
grak-split-ear.defaultDisposition: indifferent to weaklings, hostile to challenges

snarl.name: Snarl
snarl.description: Lean, mean warrior who stays close to Grak. Favors a scavenged spear.
snarl.currentGoal: Stay in Grak's favor and take what he can

grik.name: Grik
grik.description: Broad-shouldered for a goblin. Enjoys the privileges of being one of the leader's favored and the chance to bully others.
grik.currentGoal: Maintain his place near the top of the hierarchy
grik.defaultDisposition: hostile to those who show weakness or defiance
